name: PIRA-Bench
intro: PIRA-Bench 面向无显式指令的主动式 GUI 意图推荐。它整理 100 条真实移动端和桌面端连续轨迹，为每条轨迹注入应用切换、空闲屏幕和随机浏览噪声并配对三种用户画像，再由三名独立标注者确定可行动意图，形成直接推荐、画像依赖和纯噪声负样本三类场景。
org: MMLab @ CUHK, Nankai University, Huawei Research
build_method: 真实连续GUI轨迹, 噪声注入, 三用户画像配对, 三人独立意图标注
metric: Average Intent F1, Normalized False Positive Score, Final Score
eval_feature: 画像条件意图, 纯噪声负样本, 语义集合匹配, 误报惩罚
scale: 100条轨迹, 平均32张截图, 每条轨迹3个用户画像
intro_en: PIRA-Bench evaluates proactive GUI intent recommendation without explicit user instructions. It curates 100 real mobile and desktop trajectories, injects application switching, idle screens, and random browsing noise, pairs each trajectory with three user profiles, and uses three independent annotators to establish actionable intents across direct, profile-dependent, and pure-noise negative scenarios.
build_method_en: Real Sequential GUI Trajectories, Noise Injection, Three-profile Pairing, Three-person Independent Intent Annotation
metric_en: Average Intent F1, Normalized False Positive Score, Final Score
eval_feature_en: Profile-conditioned Intents, Pure-noise Negatives, Semantic Set Matching, False-positive Penalty
scale_en: 100 trajectories, 32 screenshots on average, 3 user profiles per trajectory

drawio_review_note: reviewed_at=2026-07-22; source-stage only. Primary paper is fixed to arXiv:2603.08013v1; the downloaded PDF SHA-256 is b75a527baea198e7a9b3bbb93195fb8b4d5e29e40a98c9720b5d0862c9f58015. The official Hugging Face dataset is fixed to revision 26194bfba20d90304ca3c6fe728bbbc65fa927a5; its README SHA-256 is 3e29289cf9a3844f22b1650c02fb9ab28c17509c5e081b55d479df43ac771494 and its recursive tree response SHA-256 is 38ddab3601e6f8426616a6f8c3cb21bcf37d8b1752f9901cf3d050269be04d10. That snapshot contains README.md and trajs.zip; trajs.zip is 6,794,715,214 bytes with LFS SHA-256 d9677ed4aada60ad2d3745ddfdd51a2378bdd28735a193820ad3d29529951392. The dataset card says the archive expands to 100 trajectory folders, each containing screenshots and profile.json, and defines the submission shape as trajectory to Profile_A/Profile_B/Profile_C to arrays of intent strings. The card declares Apache-2.0. It does not publish ground-truth intent sets or a standalone evaluator. The official leaderboard page HTML was fixed by SHA-256 a1da2a91fe24132611f5953fffb14bf2644ded2b74526b5f85b80a1f178143d2; its public client bundle SHA-256 is da4680a1a8660df76a7e1bddca3a03b78e6453162d5254ffb5895c84cc3aab5d. The client validates the public JSON shape and queues authenticated scoring through /api/score, but the server-side scorer is not downloadable. The paper workflow is preserved exactly: 100 real mobile and desktop passive-observation trajectories; temporal screenshot sequences; universal application-switching, idle-screen, and random-browsing noise; three socioeconomic, preference, and characteristic profiles per trajectory; a mixed distribution of direct recommendation, profile-dependent, and pure-noise cases; three independent human annotations per trajectory-profile pair; ground truth retaining intents named by at least two of three annotators; empty ground-truth sets for pure noise or profile-negated cases; prediction without an explicit user instruction; and Gemini-3-flash semantic comparison supplied with profile context. Positive samples use per-trajectory intent F1 followed by macro averaging. Negative samples use FPS as average hallucinated intents per negative case and FPSnorm = 1/(1+ln(1+FPS)). Final Score is Average Intent F1 multiplied by FPSnorm. The judge prompt, semantic-match parser, tie handling, judge generation settings, ground truth, and offline evaluator remain undisclosed and are therefore represented only as a dashed evaluation boundary. The paper itself has a wording drift: the abstract says an average of 32 sequential screenshots, while the contribution paragraph says an average of 33; the public dataset card does not reconcile the difference, so the detail scale retains the abstract's 32 and the discrepancy is explicit in the diagram. Formal drawio/svg/png/arch assets were not changed during this source-stage review. Formal publication evidence [site-a12c-paper-alignment]: normalized Draw.io and architecture sidecars plus native fixed-light SVG/PNG pairs were regenerated from the checked-in bilingual specs. Final PNG dimensions are 3325×1041 (English) and 3327×1041 (Chinese); SVG viewBoxes are 3323×1039 and 3325×1039. The final exports were inspected without clipping, node overlap, connector-node crossing, fallback text, or adaptive colors.
